segments.text: What if Zoro finally learned directions? A map just felt unfamiliar respect.
segments.label: GPS HAS ENTERED THE CHAT

segments.text: Nami tests him. Left means left. Incredible. Bro unlocked a feature available on most shopping carts.
segments.label: THE NAVIGATOR IS SUSPICIOUS

segments.text: He reaches the meeting first. Then the enemy base. Then the problem. His crew isn't there.
segments.label: ARRIVING BEFORE THE PLOT

segments.text: Early doesn't mean invincible. He's inside an ambush with three swords and zero emotional support.
segments.label: EARLY IS NOT INVINCIBLE

segments.text: Luffy is still causing trouble elsewhere. We fixed navigation, not the crew's relationship with planning.
segments.label: THE CAPTAIN IS STILL THE CAPTAIN

segments.text: Zoro spots extra guards. This time he knows how far away his backup is.
segments.label: SOMETHING IS WRONG HERE

segments.text: So he retreats and marks the approach. Character development arrives wearing earrings and refusing eye contact.
segments.label: THE SMART MOVE IS BACKWARD

segments.text: He warns Nami. They pick a better route and arrive together. The enemies lose their easiest advantage.
segments.label: A RENDEZVOUS FOR ONCE

segments.text: Now he fights with cover instead of auditioning for a cautionary flashback. Timing beats stubbornness here.
segments.label: THE REAL UPGRADE

segments.text: He still argues with instructions. His complaints reach the correct address.
segments.label: THE JOKE CHANGES SHAPE

segments.text: Nami buys a compass. Zoro asks if it comes in sword form. Navigation needs a damage stat, apparently.
segments.label: SWORDS HAVE OPTIONS

segments.text: They finally travel together. Luffy points toward the wrong island. Excellent. The navigation disease found another host.
segments.label: THE FINAL TURN
